Patch Set 3:

(7 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. The two build-side pieces do not hold together: the new autoconf test cannot compile as written, so HAVE_ITER_IOV_LEN is never defined, and that is the only reason the new compat helper still exists on modern kernels.

commit.message:
LU-18687 build: iov_iter_iovec to iter_iov_len, iter_iov_addr

Add HAVE_ITER_IOV_LEN to ensure an iter_iov_len() is
available.

iov_iter_iovec() is dropped and the address and bytes from the
segment are accessed directly.

This is done to align with the upstream linux kernel.

Test-Parameters: trivial
Signed-off-by: Shaun Tancheff <shaun@tancheff.com>
Change-Id: I906b248d03f30a765f27b0916419b88ee178d6a5
